1.prompt: A dark editing desk at the first second of someone else's film: a blank monitor just catching the first frame of a picture, dust in a thin violet shaft, a character arriving before boredom can. No interface, no play button, no platform logo, no readable UI.

2.prompt: An emptied cinema after the credits: a single projector beam still crossing rows of dark red seats. The hall is a companion, not a bed. No violin, no audience, no marquee lettering.

3.prompt: A hotel ballroom foyer just before an evening: warm lights coming up, a few dark-clothed figures arriving, shoulders lifting on their own. People not yet friends and no longer strangers. No name badges with writing, no banner, no toast.

4.prompt: A figure seated on the floor of a dim quiet room, back to the camera, an open night window, permission to exhale. Fog of breath in cool air. No spa candles, no yoga studio brand, no lake postcard.

5.prompt: A dusk city street in one short flash: a shop window catching amber for a blink, a hand mid-gesture, colour saying something before anyone can. Heat in the palms, a pulse under the pavement. No billboard text, no brand logo, no carnival.
